sections.title: Image slot
sections.what: Shows one image using the pixel effect. On devices without hover, adds a transparent tap layer that toggles the reveal.
sections.why: Touch screens cannot hover, so a tap is used instead.
sections.watch_out: The tap layer appears only on devices without hover.

sections.name: VideoMedia
sections.title: Video slot
sections.what: Shows a video player for a real file, an embedded player for an embed link, or a placeholder frame with a play icon and a hint to replace the file.
sections.why: The placeholder shows the expected shape and aspect ratio before the video exists.
sections.watch_out: The placeholder text names the assets data file, so keep that name accurate.

summary: Shows an image or video slot: the real file if one is given, otherwise a labelled placeholder.
purpose: Used on project pages for screenshots and demo videos, so each slot looks right before real media is added.
why: Lets the site show its layout before every file exists.
how: For images, renders the shared pixel image with the slot's caption. For videos, shows a player for a real file, an embedded player for an embed link, or a placeholder frame.
inputs: A slot from the assets data, a project title and code, and a number for the video label or seed.
outputs: A figure with media and a caption that says Placeholder when no file is set.
risks: Relies on the assets data for file paths. A placeholder hint names the data file to edit.
debug: If a slot shows Placeholder, check the asset entry in the assets data. If a video will not play, check the source path or embed link. If a tap layer blocks clicks, check the touch detection.
